verdict.rationale: Claude documents a first-party data export: individual users can export user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy, and the export covers conversation data plus account user data. Enterprise also offers a Compliance API for programmatic access to chat histories and file content. The evidence does not state the export file format, so the 'open formats' part is unproven, and it does not confirm that 'all' data (projects, artifacts, memory, uploaded files) is included. missing for 10: documented open export format (e.g. JSON/Markdown), confirmation that projects/memory/files/artifacts are included, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Individual Claude users can export user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy
Data exports include conversation data and the user data for your account.
Compliance API: programmatically access Claude usage data including activity logs, chat histories, and file content
